_comment: Cards that exist only for the cast-off-the-top tests (tests/unit/casting/test_cast_from_library_top.py and test_cast_from_library_top_filter.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_citadel` is Bolas's Citadel's middle line: cast spells off the top of your library, paying life equal to mana value instead of mana. `t_thundermane` is Thundermane Dragon's: creature spells with power 4 or greater off the top at their printed cost, gaining haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Test Citadel
cards.oracle_text: You may play lands and cast spells from the top of your library. If you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than pay its mana cost.
